subject: Discovery follow-up: rotating demo slots across US/EU/APAC
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@datagrid.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-08T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery follow-up + rotating demo slots (US/EU/APAC)

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the intro call today — really enjoyed learning about DataGrid's ingestion pipeline and latency targets. As discussed, we'd like to get a technical deep-dive scheduled with your infra lead so we can map our KV-caching and batching recommendations to your traffic patterns.

To keep things fair for distributed teams, Camila and Aditya suggested a rotating demo cadence that alternates times across US / EU / APAC windows. That way the engineers on each side of the globe get an equitable slot over a multi-week run.

Attached is a short proposal that outlines two rotation patterns and suggested agendas for the 60-minute deep dive. Quick summary of the two options:
- Option A (Weekly rotation): Week 1 — US-friendly slot, Week 2 — EU-friendly slot, Week 3 — APAC-friendly slot
- Option B (Bi-weekly alternation): US/EU one week, APAC the next (good if the APAC group only needs occasional sessions)

Proposed slots (all times shown in local time for each region):
- US-friendly: Tue 9:00 AM PT / 12:00 PM ET
- EU-friendly: Wed 2:00 PM BST / 3:00 PM CEST
- APAC-friendly: Thu 10:00 AM SGT / 11:30 AM AEST

Could you confirm: (1) which rotation approach you prefer, (2) 2-3 names/emails of the engineers who should join the deep dive, and (3) whether you prefer a recurring invite or individual invites per meeting?

If it's easier, feel free to pick a slot directly via our scheduling page: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-rotation

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-demo-rotation-proposal.pdf (1 page)
Attachment: team-availability.csv (stub)

- US week (example first occurrence): Tue Jul 14, 2026 — 9:00 AM PT (16:00 UTC)
- EU week (example first occurrence): Wed Jul 21, 2026 — 3:00 PM CEST (13:00 UTC)
